text: Before the producer hands in a candidate, compare its diff with the plan's planned files and expected deliverables. If any are left unchanged, the producer must either change them or say why in its report, before verification starts. In both jobs (branch operator/next5) the verifier found a major finding: the listed test files under crates/athena-cli/tests were not changed. In y179 the verifier also says common/mod.rs and run.rs were not changed. Add a test that a candidate missing a planned file is flagged. Note: the missed time target in these same jobs is already queued as performance-target-criterion-set-without-measured-feasibility. This item is only about the missing planned files.
